title: Three-Day Agreement
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji's words fell, a sharp aura suddenly pierced through from outside the door—Han Lie's face, filled with accusations, appeared at the entrance of the Council Hall.

text.content: Late at night, in a hidden cave dwelling at the edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, candlelight flickered, casting dancing shadows on the walls. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back before a stone table, where an unfurled sheepskin map was marked with dozens of red cinnabar circles, each corresponding to a dangerous node within the ancient secret realm. Three months. The countdown of an entire three months now had only three days remaining.

dialogue.content: (Pushes through the door, voice cold) Chen Ji, you summoned us in the dead of night—what is this about? Isn't the secret realm opening still three days away?

text.content: Su Qingyao's usual cold tone could not entirely conceal the fleeting concern in her eyes. She was the only one who could sense that Chen Ji was 'problematic,' yet every time she approached the truth, he brushed it aside with nonchalance. Tonight she had specifically changed into a fitted combat outfit, clearly prepared long in advance.

dialogue.content: (Steps in lightly, demonic energy swirling around her) Three days? In three days, the Xuanwu Sect's 'genius' will lead people to storm the secret realm. My Holy Sect's informants sent word—Han Lie has already declared he will 'clean house' in the secret realm. Heh, what arrogance.

text.content: Ye Qing's words carried undisguised mockery. Clad in a black纱裙, demonic energy condensed into wisps of mist around her fingertips, her enchanting face filled with contempt for the so-called 'righteous genius.' The Holy Sect's Saintess of the Demonic Path, conspiring with the Tianqing Sect's trash disciple—this alone was a secret足以引爆整个修仙界.

dialogue.content: (Turns around, gaze calm as a deep pool) Clean house? Han Lie remains as foolish as ever. Does he think the secret realm is his private garden? Though... Ye Qing, you said you had important intelligence to share in person—what is it?

(Expression suddenly turns grave) There's been upheaval within my Holy Sect. The commander position has remained vacant for some time. But while organizing old archives, I discovered something intriguing—thirty years ago, our sect tracked a person's bloodline, said to be the 'Key to Heavenly Secrets,' capable of opening an ancient forbidden land. That person's surname... was Chen.

text.content: Ye Qing's words fell, and the air within the cave dwelling seemed to freeze. Su Qingyao's brow furrowed almost imperceptibly, her gaze toward Chen Ji now carrying more scrutiny. Yet Chen Ji himself showed no change in expression, as if Ye Qing had spoken of nothing more than an insignificant old matter.

dialogue.content: (Smiles faintly) Plenty of people have the surname Chen. What does that prove?

(Steps closer, lowers voice) Chen Ji, since I chose to cooperate with you, I don't make baseless claims. The person being tracked was recorded as a 'Tianqing Sect fugitive disciple,' and the time of his disappearance... was precisely one year before your birth. Dare you claim that's coincidence?

text.content: A flicker of emotion crossed Chen Ji's eyes, but vanished in an instant. He lowered his gaze to the map on the table, as if deep in thought. In reality, his mind was racing—Ye Qing's intelligence was closer to the truth than he'd anticipated. That 'fugitive disciple' was none other than his father. And his long-missing sister, Chen Nian, might be exactly what the Holy Sect calls the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key.'

dialogue.content: (Speaks suddenly) Enough. Regardless of Chen Ji's origins, the most pressing matter is—the secret realm dispute in three days. Since Han Lie has made his declaration, he certainly won't let it rest. We need a counter-strategy.

text.content: Su Qingyao's words broke the oppressive atmosphere. She was the Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect; with her present, this clandestine meeting at least carried the nominal guise of 'sect internal affairs.' Yet at that moment, Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly—he sensed a faint presence outside the cave dwelling, watching.

That presence carried extremely subtle spiritual energy fluctuations. Had Chen Ji not spent years feigning weakness and honing perception far beyond ordinary people, he would never have detected it. Though carefully hidden, the aura exuded a familiar, aggressive dominance—the unmistakable energy signature of Xuanwu Sect techniques. Han Lie's man? Or... Han Lie himself?

dialogue.content: (Suddens laughs lightly) How interesting. Ladies and gentlemen, it seems our meeting tonight isn't as private as we'd hoped.

choice.prompt: The monitor's presence was achingly familiar—nearly certain to be connected to Han Lie. Facing this potential threat, Chen Ji had to make a choice:

choices.text: Take the initiative, confront and expose
choices.description: Walk directly out of the cave dwelling, expose the monitor's identity before everyone present, catch the enemy off guard, and demonstrate absolute control.
choices.visible_cost: May alert the enemy, giving them time to prepare
choices.risk_hint: If there is more than one monitor, may fall into a passive situation

dialogue.content: (Rises, walks out with hands behind back) Ladies and gentlemen, please wait. I'll invite our 'uninvited guest' in.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji pushed open the door, Ye Qing's demonic energy immediately spread into a barrier while Su Qingyao rested her hand on her sword hilt,蓄势待发. The默契 between the three was as if they'd rehearsed it countless times.

choices.text: Lay a hidden trap, draw out the snake
choices.description: Feign ignorance, continue strategic deployment as planned, while secretly using the Tianji Record to deduce the monitor's purpose and set a counter-trap.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consumption of Heavenly Fate to use Tianji Record abilities
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete intelligence, know yourself and your enemy
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption is irreversible, and divination may not be complete

dialogue.content: (Sits down without changing expression) No matter. Just a rat eavesdropping. Let's continue—the formation eye arrangement on the west side of the secret realm is what matters.

text.content: Chen Ji quietly extended a thread of divine consciousness outside the cave dwelling while lightly touching the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. A moment later, the corner of his mouth curved slightly—as expected, the monitor's presence was indeed Han Lie himself.

choices.text: Test loyalty, use the knife to kill
choices.description: Deliberately leak a piece of 'false intelligence,' testing whether any of the three present is in league with the monitor—kill two birds with one stone.
choices.visible_reward: Root out the insider, solidify the inner circle
choices.risk_hint: If an ally is wrongly accused, relationship repair will be difficult

dialogue.content: (After a moment of contemplation) Ye Qing, you mentioned the Holy Sect commander position is vacant... I wonder if they have interest in this secret realm? I hear there's apparently a heaven-shaking opportunity within that can reverse bloodlines.

text.content: The words were spoken lightly, yet precisely dangled a temptation足以让所有人动心. If anyone leaked this news... Chen Ji's gaze subtly swept across the expressions of the three present.

Ye Qing was the first to take up the topic, detailing the terrain and prohibitions within the secret realm. Her voice echoed through the cave dwelling, every word precise and professional. Yet Chen Ji's attention lingered on Su Qingyao's whitened knuckles gripping the sword hilt—a signal of tension. Was she worried for him, or something else?

dialogue.content: (Unfurls a yellowed sheepskin scroll) This is the layout map of the secret realm's second layer. My Holy Sect spent three generations of lives before barely completing this drawing. There are seven formation eyes; if we occupy four, we can constrain the secret realm's core operation.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's displayed map of the secret realm was extremely valuable, but Chen Ji noticed Su Qingyao's expression was off. At this critical moment, he had to decide his next move:

choices.text: Confront Su Qingyao on the spot
choices.description: Directly point out Su Qingyao's unusual reaction, force her to declare her stance publicly, use high-pressure tactics to test her position.
choices.risk_hint: If she truly has issues, may turn hostile on the spot

dialogue.content: (Stares directly at Su Qingyao) Senior Sister Su, you seem to have... some other view of this layout map?

text.content: Su Qingyao's body visibly stiffened for a moment, and complex light flickered in those proud eyes. Panic at being exposed, or something else?

choices.description: Focus attention on the layout map, confront Su Qingyao privately later, preserve room for maneuvering.
choices.visible_cost: Gives the enemy more preparation time

dialogue.content: (Withdraws gaze, continues studying the layout map) This formation eye's position slightly differs from my previous deduction... Ye Qing, could you elaborate on the third formation eye?

text.content: Su Qingyao seemed to sense Chen Ji's fleeting glance; her hand slowly released from the sword hilt, and the emotions in her eyes收敛. Chen Ji mentally noted this detail—the Inner Sect Senior Fellow was indeed hiding secrets.

Just as Chen Ji prepared to press further, that faint presence outside the cave dwelling suddenly grew restless—the monitor appeared to have lost patience. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, for he sensed that presence rapidly approaching, and... more than one.

dialogue.content: (Expression sharpens) They're here. At least three presences outside, and one of them... is Xuanwu Sect's domineering cultivation technique!

text.content: Before Ye Qing finished speaking, the cave dwelling's stone door was smashed open from outside by a single punch. As debris scattered, a tall figure stood silhouetted against the light, radiating a searing, fire-like spiritual energy—Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, Han Lie. Behind him trailed two attendants with profound auras.

dialogue.content: (Storms into the cave, surveys the room, sneering) Heh, quite a gathering. A Tianqing Sect trash servant disciple, actually has the Holy Sect's Saintess as company? Chen Ji, who exactly are you, to make such moves right under my Xuanwu Sect's nose?

text.content: Han Lie's voice echoed through the cave dwelling, carrying undisguised contempt. His tiger eyes bore into Chen Ji, as if trying to discern fear and panic on that calm face. Yet Chen Ji's reaction left him greatly disappointed—those deep eyes held not the slightest ripple.

dialogue.content: (Unhurriedly straightens robes) Han Senior Brother visits so late at night, to what do we owe the honor? Senior Sister Su and I were discussing matters—I don't recall inviting outsiders. I wonder how Xuanwu Sect people 'happened' to appear at Tianqing Sect's Back Mountain?

text.content: Chen Ji's words were measured yet precisely struck Han Lie's sore point—unauthorized intrusion into another sect's territory was a grave offense under any circumstances. Han Lie's expression darkened slightly, clearly aware of this. But the two attendants behind him wore dissatisfied looks, clearly not planning to let it go.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) Outsiders? Chen Ji, stop playing dumb. I ask you—what scheme are you plotting for the secret realm dispute in three days? The things within that secret realm are not for trash like you to covet! Be sensible and withdraw now, and I'll pretend nothing happened.

text.content: Han Lie's words dripped with menace, his spiritual energy pressing toward Chen Ji like a tangible force. Yet Chen Ji seemed oblivious to that pressure; he merely tilted his head slightly, glancing at Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, a meaningful smile curling at his lips.

choice.prompt: Han Lie openly issues threats. Faced with this sudden confrontation, Chen Ji must decide:

choices.text: Teach Han Lie a lesson on the spot
choices.description: Have Ye Qing and Su Qingyao join forces—two against one—humiliate Han Lie before everyone and strip him of all pride, making him a laughingstock.
choices.visible_cost: May expose our side's true strength
choices.risk_hint: Xuanwu Sect may intensify retaliation afterward

dialogue.content: (Laughs lightly) Han Senior Brother threatens me? Ye Qing, Senior Sister Su, it seems our guest doesn't understand proper etiquette.

text.content: A seductive curve formed at the corner of Ye Qing's lips, her demonic energy erupting in an instant. Su Qingyao pressed her hand to her sword hilt, spiritual energy surging like a tide. The two flanked Han Lie in a pincer formation. Han Lie's expression finally shifted—he hadn't expected Chen Ji to have such powerful allies.

choices.description: Avoid using force, instead publicly expose Han Lie's weaknesses through words, making him a laughingstock in everyone's eyes. Psychologically shatter his superiority.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke Han Lie into immediate violence
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie's mental defenses crumble, easier to manipulate afterward
choices.risk_hint: If言辞不够犀利, may backfire

dialogue.content: (Unhurriedly) Trash? Qualified? Han Senior Brother, I recall three months ago, you and I met outside the Scripture Repository. At the time you said the secret realm's fortune belonged to you, and I didn't even have the qualification to glance at it. And then? When that secret realm opened, the ones who walked out alive... didn't seem to include anyone from Xuanwu Sect, did they?

text.content: These words landed like a thunderclap; Han Lie's face flushed crimson. His two attendants exchanged glances, clearly recalling that disastrous defeat. Su Qingyao's lips curved upward slightly, and Ye Qing openly laughed.

Han Lie's fists clenched audibly. He never imagined this trash servant disciple he'd always dismissed would dare openly defy him. What infuriated him more—the two attendants behind him were now looking at him with a hint of doubt. When had Xuanwu Sect's number one genius ever endured such humiliation?

dialogue.content: (Grinding teeth) Fine... fine indeed, you silver-tongued trash! Chen Ji, remember this—within the secret realm in three days, I will make you pay for today's words! We're leaving!

text.content: Han Lie swept his sleeve and stormed out. His two attendants followed closely, but as one passed Chen Ji, a complex emotion flickered in his eyes. Chen Ji silently noted this detail—Han Lie's attendants were not a solid bloc.

dialogue.content: (Watches Han Lie depart, voice cold) He won't let this go. With Han Lie's temperament, he'll definitely make a move in the secret realm in three days. Do you... have any把握?

text.content: Su Qingyao's question carried rare concern. She had known Chen Ji for years yet never truly understood this man. Gazing at his nonchalant profile, an inexplicable emotion stirred within her. Just how many hidden cards did this 'trash' still hold?

dialogue.content: (Gazes at the night sky, tone indifferent)把握? Senior Sister Su, when have you ever seen me act without certainty? The three-day agreement... Heh, I've been waiting for this day far too long.

text.content: Moonlight fell upon Chen Ji's face, illuminating the fleeting sharpness gleaming in those deep eyes. The three-month countdown had only three days remaining. And the chess game he had meticulously constructed was finally about to enter its most critical phase. Ye Qing was right—the secret realm did hold a heaven-shaking fortune capable of reversing bloodlines. But the true master of that fortune could only be Chen Ji. Outside the cave dwelling, the night wind howled. The curtain rose on the three-day agreement.
